LanguageData.Matrilineal_Settings_ForceFemale_Desc: When enabled, all children conceived from a carrier of this gene will always be born female.
LanguageData.Matrilineal_Settings_InheritXenotype_Des: When enabled, daughters directly inherit their genetic mother's Xenotype and endogene pool instead of creating a random hybrid.
LanguageData.Matrilineal_Settings_Notification_Desc: Shows a special notification message when a matrilineal daughter is born.
LanguageData.Matrilineal_Message_DaughterBorn: A matrilineal daughter ({BABY}) has been born to {MOTHER}, preserving the matriarchal lineage!
